name: MIRI_pathways
description: Programmatically rebuilt MIRI pathway gene sets. Sources: GEO DEG enrichment (GSE160516 mouse primary, GSE108940 rat, GSE137293 pig) + gpt-researcher literature survey. KEGG/GO gene sets from Enrichr, intersected with L1000 978 landmark genes. Filters: n_l1000 > 5 AND n_l1000/n_total >= 978/20000 (=0.0489). UP = pathway activated in MIRI (drug should DOWN-regulate). DOWN = pathway suppressed in MIRI (drug should UP-regulate).
